definitions.explanation: A collective reference to many different things, implying a wide range of items, factors, or matters.

examples.japanese: {諸々|もろもろ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{事情|じじょう}→事情：03272_jijou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
{諸々|もろもろ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{費用|ひよう}→費用：03588_hiyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{含|ふく}める→含める：02408_fukumeru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{結構|けっこう}→結構：10387_kekkou⟧な⟦{金額|きんがく}→金額：02665_kingaku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: When you include all the various costs, it comes to a considerable amount.

examples.japanese: {引|ひ}っ{越|こ}し⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{際|さい}→際：02819_sai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{住所|じゅうしょ}→住所：01430_juusho⟧⟦{変更|へんこう}→変更：03616_henkou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{届|とど}け{出|で}⟦など→〜など：03095_nado⟧{諸々|もろもろ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{手続|てつづ}き→手続き：05453_tetsuzuki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧だ。
examples.english: When moving, various procedures such as address change notifications are required.

notes:
{諸々|もろもろ} means "various" or "all sorts of." It has a slightly formal or mature tone.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {諸々|もろもろ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ + noun (various [things])
- {諸々|もろもろ} as a standalone noun meaning "various things"

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {諸々|もろもろ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{事情|じじょう}→事情：03272_jijou⟧ (various circumstances)
- {諸々|もろもろ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{費用|ひよう}→費用：03588_hiyou⟧ (various expenses)
- {諸々|もろもろ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{手続|てつづ}き→手続き：05453_tetsuzuki⟧ (various procedures)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {諸々|もろもろ} vs ⟦{色々|いろいろ}→色々：02352_iroiro⟧: Both mean "various," but {諸々|もろもろ} is more formal and often used in written or business contexts, while ⟦{色々|いろいろ}→色々：02352_iroiro⟧ is more conversational and widely used in everyday speech.
